primaryCorroboratedReview.reachability: Shared request/provider schemas contain arrays (for example packages/types/src/task.ts:24). The upstream v4 fix moves collection-size checks before element parsing: in affected implementations, schema .max/.length/.size alone do not prevent walking oversized input or accumulating element errors. The API has a512kb JSON body limit at index.ts219; this is not proof against validation amplification or provider-input paths. Complete route/input amplification review or reproduction not performed.
primaryCorroboratedReview.decision: Direct production package version match; bounded audit does not establish exploitable memory exhaustion.
